Class WebLNWallet

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.wallets.webln.WebLNWallet
All Implemented Interfaces:
Wallet
public class WebLNWallet extends Object implements Wallet
WebLN browser wallet, accessed through the platform's JavaScript function bridge. Constructing a wallet never prompts for permissions; call waitForReady() from a user action. Providers do not expose standard invoice lookup or transaction history APIs.

  • Constructor Details

    • WebLNWallet

      public WebLNWallet()
      Creates a browser wallet adapter without requesting provider permissions. Invoke waitForReady() from a user action to enable the provider. Closing the adapter releases its executor and pending local waits; it cannot revoke a submitted payment.

  • Method Details

    • request

      protected org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<Object> request(String method, List<?> args)
      Invokes a method on the browser's WebLN provider through the platform bridge. The default target is window.webln. Hosts without a window, such as SharedWorkers, can override this method and the capability probe to route calls to their owner.
      Parameters:
      method - provider method name without the window.webln prefix
      args - arguments forwarded to the provider
      Returns:
      task containing the provider's result or failure

    • hasMethod

      protected org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<Boolean> hasMethod(String method)
      Checks for a browser runtime and a provider method through the default browser bridge. Override together with request() when routing provider calls through another host.
      Parameters:
      method - provider method name without the window.webln prefix
      Returns:
      whether the provider exposes the requested method

    • isAvailable

      public org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<Boolean> isAvailable()
      Checks for the provider's enable method without asking for permissions. Availability does not imply that the provider is enabled or supports every wallet method.
      Specified by:
      isAvailable in interface Wallet
      Returns:
      whether this open adapter can reach a WebLN provider

    • getReceivingAddress

      public String getReceivingAddress()
      Returns the optional receiving-address suggestion reported by the provider. The value comes from lud16, lightningAddress or lud06 and may be absent. It is not inferred from the node identity, and publishing it requires the user's consent.
      Returns:
      the last provider suggestion, or null when unavailable or cleared on close

    • waitForReady

      public org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<Boolean> waitForReady()
      Enables the provider and loads its wallet information. Call this from a user action because enable may prompt for permission. Concurrent callers share one attempt; a failed attempt can be retried explicitly. Ready wallets and existing attempts use volatile reads before the initialization monitor.
      Specified by:
      waitForReady in interface Wallet
      Returns:
      task reporting readiness, or a failure when the provider is unavailable or closed
